project_specification.project_name: nullius — user-journey gaps (HTTP API transport, status-decidable refusals, operator dashboard completeness)
project_specification.addition_summary: Close the gaps a browser validation of the system's user journeys found (docs/user-journeys/RESULTS.md, run 1). app_spec.xml's api_endpoints_summary promises ten HTTP routes — POST /target, POST /ledger/debit, GET /ledger/k-effective, POST /promotion/pre-register, POST /forward/promote, GET /forward/decay, POST /risk/halt, GET /metrics/fdr-deploy, GET /metrics/instrument-status and GET /metrics/regime-coverage — and every one exists only as an in-process endpoint object (FdrDeployEndpoint, DebitEndpoint, HaltEndpoint, …) with a route constant and a get/post method; nothing serves them over HTTP, so every API journey ends in ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED. This addition ships a new `api` workspace member that serves the composed application's endpoints over HTTP with JSON bodies and a decidable status for every outcome, gives three endpoints the distinct refusal classes that make that status decidable, and completes the Streamlit operator dashboard with the two elements app_spec.xml's ui_layout and the M5 ux line require but the page does not render — the three instrument lamps in permanent chrome and the provenance triple beside FDR_deploy — plus an operator-facing refusal and a local-only launch configuration.

existing_context.stack: Python 3.12 / uv-workspace (members under packages/*, composed by src/app/module_loader.create_app) / SQLite stores addressed by DATABASE_URL / pytest (ruff conventions)
existing_context.test_baseline: workspace suite tests/ 1579 passing; member suites under packages/*/tests (ops, promotion, forward, providers …) all passing on main
existing_context.conventions: snake_case modules, frozen dataclasses for value types, stdlib-first members (a member adds no third-party lockfile edge unless it must), docstrings citing app_spec.xml feature numbers and docs/nullius-tech-architecture.md sections, refusals raised as typed errors whose message opens with a greppable code word and names the one repair, degrade-don't-break composition (a builder returns None when its environment is unconfigured), @register only in a package __init__, cross-member imports deferred past module scope. Tests assert observed behaviour with narrative docstrings. Member suites and the workspace suite are run as separate pytest invocations.

feature.description: System raises PromotionConflictError, a subclass of PromotionError, when a node is re-registered with different criteria, which returns an error message naming both criteria hashes, so a caller can tell a conflict from a malformed request

System raises PromotionParentAbsentError, a subclass of PromotionStoreError, when a pre-registration names a node or epoch row that does not exist, which returns an error message naming the absent row, so a caller can tell a missing parent from an unwritable store

System raises ForwardAbsentError, a subclass of ForwardStoreError, when a decay curve is asked for a node with no forward record or no observation yet, or a promotion names a node with no node row, which returns an error message naming the node, so a caller can tell an absence from a store failure

System serves the composed application over HTTP from the api workspace member built on the standard library's ThreadingHTTPServer with python -m nullius_api, which returns a JSON body for every response and binds 127.0.0.1 by default

System answers every refusal as a structured JSON error carrying the code word, the error class and the message, which returns 400 for a malformed body, 404 for an unknown path, 405 with an Allow header for a wrong verb and 503 naming the missing configuration for an unconfigured component, and never includes a traceback or a filesystem path

System requires a bearer token on every route except GET /healthz, read from the token file NULLIUS_API_TOKENS_FILE names with each token scoped to metrics:read, research, evaluator or risk, which returns 401 for a missing or unknown token, 403 for a token outside the route's scope, and refuses to start when no token is configured

System caps a request body at 1 MiB and a socket read at 10 seconds, which returns 413 for an oversized body and 408 for a request that stalls, so one slow caller cannot hold a worker the halt route needs

System emits one structured access-log record per request carrying the token's scope name, verb, route, status and latency and never the request body or the token, which saves to the nullius_api.access logger

System refuses to bind a non-loopback host unless NULLIUS_API_TLS_CERT and NULLIUS_API_TLS_KEY name a certificate and key, which returns a startup error message naming the missing file, and serves HTTPS through the standard library's ssl module when they do, so a bearer token never crosses a network in cleartext

System serves GET /metrics/fdr-deploy, GET /metrics/instrument-status and GET /metrics/regime-coverage as JSON, which returns 200 with null or empty fields when the store holds no rows rather than a fabricated zero, and 503 with the code word for a store failure
System serves POST /ledger/debit and GET /ledger/k-effective as JSON, which returns 201 for an appended charge and 200 with the same sequence number for an idempotent retry

System serves POST /promotion/pre-register as JSON, which returns 201 for a new registration, 200 for an identical retry, 409 when the node is re-registered with different criteria and 422 when the node or epoch row is absent
System serves POST /forward/promote and GET /forward/decay?node_id= as JSON, which returns 404 for a node with no forward record or no observation yet and 503 only for a store failure

System serves POST /target as JSON, which returns 404 for a node the sidecar does not know and an identical 503 refusal for a known null node and a known real node when no target series supply is wired

System serves POST /risk/halt against an execution engine bound at server start from NULLIUS_EXECUTION_ENGINE, which returns 200 with the kill instruction and flatten result, and returns 503 execution_engine_unbound when no engine is bound
System serves GET / as an HTML index listing every route with its verb and whether its component is configured, and GET /healthz, which returns 200

System seeds a demo metrics store through the members' public stores with python -m nullius_api.demo, which saves to the named database closed-campaign FDR rows, sealed epochs, regime coverage, instrument readings, a pre-registered and decided node with forward observations, trial-ledger charges and node rows carrying the provenance triple, and provides an in-memory paper execution engine for the halt route

System displays the canary, KS guard and ingest instrument lamps in the dashboard's permanent chrome on every render, which shows each lamp as lit or dark and a lamp with no reading as no reading rather than lit

System displays the newest campaign's provenance triple of evaluator_hash, snapshot_hash and cost_model_hash beside FDR_deploy on the primary panel, read from that campaign's node rows, which shows provenance unrecorded when no node carries it and displays a mixed provenance error message when the campaign's nodes disagree

System displays a dashboard refusal as an operator-facing error message naming the code word and the one repair with no traceback, and displays each point of the FDR_deploy trend labelled by its campaign's computed_at instant rather than a bare index

System passes an end-to-end test that boots the HTTP server on an ephemeral port against a seeded demo store and asserts each route returns its documented HTTP status code for success, retry, absence, refusal, missing token and out-of-scope token, and that no response body contains a traceback

project_specification.integration_points: New workspace member packages/api (import name nullius_api), joining the workspace through the root packages/* glob with no edit to the root pyproject.toml; its dependencies are the workspace members whose endpoints it serves (ops, ledger, promotion, forward, nulloracle, risk) The server composes the application with app.module_loader.create_app() and looks components up with Application.get(name): ops-fdr-deploy, ops-instrument-status, ops-regime-coverage, ledger-debit, ledger-k-effective, nulloracle-target-route, risk-halt, forward-decay; the promotion and forward components return stores, so the server wraps them as PreRegisterEndpoint and PromoteEndpoint Entrypoint python -m nullius_api (flags --host, --port; environment NULLIUS_API_HOST, NULLIUS_API_PORT, NULLIUS_EXECUTION_ENGINE as a module:attribute path to the engine bound to /risk/halt) promotion/pre_register.py and forward/record.py, forward/decay.py gain the new refusal subclasses; existing except clauses keep catching them because each new class subclasses the class raised today ops/dashboard.py and ops/chrome.py read the lamps through the member's InstrumentStatusEndpoint and the triple from the node table; the dashboard's streamlit-run entrypoint stays packages/ops/src/ops/dashboard.py Covered by packages/api/tests, packages/promotion/tests, packages/forward/tests and packages/ops/tests
project_specification.constraints: The api member uses only the standard library for HTTP (http.server, json); it adds no third-party dependency to uv.lock The api member scaffold (packages/api/pyproject.toml, its dependency set, uv.lock and the src/app/modules/api seat) and the repository's .streamlit/config.toml are already committed; no feature edits the manifest, the lockfile or that configuration Streamlit stays out of the workspace lockfile: the dashboard is run with uv run --with streamlit, as packages/ops/pyproject.toml records Must not modify src/app/module_loader.py, the root pyproject.toml, pytest.ini, migrations/** or any existing endpoint's success behaviour; the new refusal classes subclass the classes raised today so every existing caller and test keeps passing The server never fabricates a figure: an empty store answers null or an empty collection, never 0.0 The POST /target refusal for a known node must be byte-identical for null and real nodes (docs §7.2's information barrier) No response body and no dashboard refusal contains a traceback or a filesystem path The server binds 127.0.0.1 unless a host is given explicitly, and it never serves a route other than GET /healthz without a valid bearer token; a missing token file is a refusal to start, not an open server Tokens and request bodies are never written to a log All existing workspace and member tests must stay green

phase.name: Phase 1: Status-Decidable Refusals and HTTP API Transport core

implementation_steps.phase: Add PromotionConflictError and PromotionParentAbsentError to promotion, and ForwardAbsentError to forward, each subclassing the class raised today Add the api member: ThreadingHTTPServer, JSON encoding of dataclasses, dates, datetimes, UUIDs and Decimals, route table, and the structured error envelope with the status mapping

Serve the three metrics routes, the two ledger routes, pre-register, forward promote and decay, target and halt, each through the composed component Serve the HTML index and /healthz; add the demo seed and the paper engine Require scoped bearer tokens, cap body size and read time, and emit the per-request access log
Add the end-to-end test that boots the server against the seeded demo store and exercises every route and status

project_specification.success_criteria: Every route except /healthz refuses a request without a valid, in-scope bearer token Every route in app_spec.xml's api_endpoints_summary answers over HTTP with a JSON body and the documented status for success, retry, absence and refusal The dashboard shows FDR_deploy with its provenance triple, three instrument lamps and the remaining clean epoch count, and refuses without a traceback docs/user-journeys J1-J14 all pass in a browser run All existing workspace and member tests still green; new tests green
